purpose: Separate a fixed request history from the earlier comparison of different histories.
primary_control: One fresh engine with the exact full-quality kwargs and history: two 256-cap waves, then the first 8192-cap wave.
comparison: Compare to the already stored full-quality history. Compare all four cases, not only equal cases.
if_control_matches: Stop the additional engine experiment. The earlier property still shows that engine kwargs plus seed alone were insufficient across different histories.
if_control_differs: Run two fresh engines with only VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING=0 changed. Keep ordinary graphs, BF16, FA3, weights, prompt, and sampling fixed.
not_a_quality_selection: No prompt, seed, cap, grade, or primary quality output changes from this diagnostic.
not_a_method: Generic engine reproducibility audit. No recurrence-specific contribution or speedup claim.
start_condition: Native full collection and the queued HF corroboration have released their GPU jobs.
